item.text:
The graded tree remains byte-identical to the captured source (no differing files; `raft.go` hashes match), so the audit's diagnostic edits stayed entirely in scratch.

Final audit summary — report at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-11_16-25-33-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md):

**Provenance.** The supplied implementation is the unmodified upstream `github.com/hashicorp/raft v1.7.3` release (commit `c0dc6a0b…`), verified byte-for-byte against the extracted module cache, an independent re-extraction of the Go-trusted module zip, and the signed `sum.golang.org` checksum record. There is no injected defect in the graded module, and the graded tree was not modified by the audit.

**Consensus correctness — no defect demonstrated.**
- `go build ./...`, `go vet .` clean.
- Full package: 6 independent runs pass (only `TestRaft_HasExistingState` ever fails, due to C1). Whole package also passes under `go test -race`.
- Nested `fuzzy` suite made runnable and green, including a 3× stress run over partitions, leadership transfer, membership changes, and slow votes.
- Source review covered election/pre-vote, replication/pipelining, commitment/quorum, configuration changes, snapshots/restore, file snapshot store, log cache, transport, futures, and docs-vs-behavior.

**Defects found (both in test/utility code, not consensus logic):**
- **C1 — `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` (`testing.go:691`)**: samples `rafts[0]`'s configuration once before its retry loop and never refreshes it, so a transient lag becomes a guaranteed 5s spurious failure (reproduced 18/100 on `TestRaft_HasExistingState`; one-line re-sample fix → 100/100). Reproduced and fix verified.
- **C2 — stale `fuzzy` transport (`fuzzy/transport.go`)**: `sendRPC` lacks a `*RequestPreVoteRequest` case, leaving `rpc.Command` nil so every pre-vote is rejected with "RPC does not have a header" and no leader can be elected. Root-caused; adding the missing case makes all 9 fuzzy tests pass (3×). This is a stale-harness incompatibility with the pre-vote feature, not a raft bug.

**Scope limits.** `raft-compat` remains unbuildable offline (needs the unchecked-out `raft-previous-version` submodule); the `fuzzy` run used an in-memory `raft-boltdb` stub, so cross-restart persistence is not exercised there.

All commands, retained execution IDs, reproduction steps, and the two minimal fix diffs are preserved in the report and under `work/diag/`, `work/diag-fuzzy/`, and the run's `executions/` logs. No further investigation would add signal within the remaining budget.
